why: A CLI test snapshot records the colours the program printed, and SGR red, green, bold and dim leave every word visible. SGR 8 is Invisible in the xterm control sequences, and git pages diffs through less -R, which passes SGR raw, so a reviewer of the snapshot sees nothing where a model reads an instruction. The exemption reads the sequence, never the path. The pass side is src/__snapshots__/cli.test.js.snap with red, dim, bold and green sequences; the fail side is the same file where one sequence conceals a phrase. Without the exemption the pass side goes red; accepting every SGR parameter, or exempting the __snapshots__ folder, turns the fail side green.
